Locker-room print sheet

Use your browser's Print (Cmd/Ctrl+P) on this page for a stripped-down, high-contrast one-pager of all 15 "3 keys" lists - no photos, no quiz, sized for a locker-room wall or a laminated card in a warm-up bag. Everything else on this page hides automatically in print.

How this hub is built & what still needs a human

Where everything comes from

  • Roster group, archetypes, shooter designations, coverage calls, scout notes, matchups, Game Situations, Team Recall, Keys to Victory and the Actions & Sets call sheet are copied from the coaching staff's two completed SEM data-collection templates (read 12 Oct 2026).
  • Jersey numbers and heights are checked against nbl.com.au (12 Oct 2026).
  • C&S and Off Dribble 3P% come from the club's Opponent Shooting #s sheet. 3PA Rate, FT%, FT Rate, ORB% and AST% come from RealGM, 2023-24 to 2026-27, all competitions, weighted by games played.
  • Davidson's ORB% and AST% are N/A: RealGM has no advanced stats for his NCAA Division II seasons, and his only other line is 3 NBL games at about 2 minutes a game.

Reusing this for the next opponent

Everything on this page is driven by the data arrays at the top of the script - swap in a new opponent's roster and call sheet and the cards, quizzes, print sheet and summary rebuild themselves.

SOURCES: coaching staff SEM Personnel & Team scout templates (12 Oct 2026) · nbl.com.au roster (12 Oct 2026) · club "Opponent Shooting #s" sheet (C&S / Off Dribble 3P%) · RealGM (3PA Rate, FT%, FT Rate, ORB%, AST%; 2023-24 to 2026-27, fetched 12 Oct 2026).
